opening.argument: The video presents itself as a dated roundup of Bihar updates, not an offer of money or rewards. Its public-affairs coverage includes health news and the release of the Bihar NEET rank list. Even where the information may be useful to viewers, such as checking a rank list or hearing prices, it is framed as reporting rather than a demand for financial participation. The request to subscribe and enable notifications is an ordinary audience-engagement prompt. Nothing in the cited material connects that request to payment, private data, or a promised outcome.
